title: Kayshon Boutte: My feet are here today, not thinking about what's next

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kayshon Boutte: My feet are here today, not thinking about what's next
sources.description: A report in June said that Patriots wide receiver Kayshon Boutte is interested in being traded and Boutte got a chance to address his feelings about being in New England on Thursday.
